purpose: The checks the plate passed before it was sent, read from its own archive.

plate_compensation_commands: G29.1 Z0 ; clear z-trim value first
stopped_mark1_engineering_print_commands: G29.1 Z0 ; clear z-trim value first
first_layer.reading: On the Engineering Plate with the 0.4 mm nozzle Bambu's own compensation sends nothing beyond the clear, so the trim's command is the nozzle's rise over Bambu's first layer.

since_that_plate_in_the_checkout: The tip's display pocket front corners stand under the cover's rim (f5125a67b). On the restored plate a tall tree rose from the bed beside the tip to carry the pocket's lower front corner from below; the corner no longer overhangs, the slicer grows no tree there, and the tip's support, its separately layered support courses and the plate's layer and object-change notices fall with it. The product plate of b0ec4b00b, after the flat dispense face (317d8a07f), still had the restored plate's layer count.
The tip's other courses and brim shift with the new mesh.
from_this_plates_commits: Base foot courses: lap and rings from 25 mm/s to the outer wall speed, held to the machine's Z feed on the steep stretches; fill from 40 and 50 mm/s to the internal solid infill speed under the volumetric limit; accelerations from 1000 to the outer wall and default accelerations; deck and plug lines from the old Z bound back to their own speed.
Foundation hops and crossings at the machine's Z feed in place of 20 and 15 mm/s.
Tip shoulder courses at the machine's Z feed in place of 7.5 mm/s of Z; the volumetric flow cap now holds some of them.
Tip shoulder interface one donor course under the first shoulder course: the interface and transition lengths move slightly.
Bed: Engineering Plate, its own foreign-object check branch, and G29.1 Z0.05 in place of G29.1 Z0.08.

harm.note: The drops that end close above plastic now come down at the machine's Z feed where they came at 20 or 15 mm/s; their count and ends are those of the plate before the change.

tip_corner_support: The tip lays support above the shoulder only at its dispense face's inner contact, at the nose's underside; none stands by the display pocket's front corners.

foot_show_lap.reading: The lap runs at the outer wall speed where it runs level and at the machine's Z feed where it climbs or drops.

tip_shoulder_footing.read_from: sculpted-trial audit-tip on this archive with the tip mesh it was prepared from

untested: No print has tested these speeds and accelerations, the tip's one course of air, the Engineering Plate first layer with its trim, or the tip's new corners.
nose_support: The tip's support above its shoulder stands only under the dispense face's inner contact, its lowest beads on the tip's own plastic, as on the restored plate.
